title: STAR-VAE: A Scalable Latent-Variable Transformer for Controllable Molecular Generation
abstract: arXiv:2511.02769v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Many molecular Transformers lack probabilistic latent variables for posterior inference and latent interpolation. We introduce STAR-VAE, a SELFIES-encoded, Transformer-based, AutoRegressive Variational AutoEncoder combining a bidirectional encoder with an autoregressive decoder pretrained on 79 million PubChem molecules. A property signal jointly conditions the prior, posterior, and decoder, while LoRA adapters support fine-tuning on small datasets without modifying the backbone. STAR-VAE achieves 100% validity and near-perfect novelty under unconditional MOSES sampling, the lowest KL divergence on five of ten GuacaMol descriptors, Spearman \r{ho} = 0.62 at 98% validity for synthetic-accessibility conditioning, and directional docking-score control for three Tartarus protein targets. translated_title: STAR-VAE：一种用于可控分子生成的可扩展潜变量Transformer
translated_abstract: 许多分子Transformer缺乏用于后验推断和潜空间插值的概率潜变量。我们提出了STAR-VAE，这是一种基于SELFIES编码、Transformer架构的自回归变分自编码器（VAE），它将双向编码器与自回归解码器相结合，并在7900万个PubChem分子上进行了预训练。属性信号同时对先验、后验和解码器进行条件化，而LoRA适配器支持在不修改主干网络的情况下在小数据集上进行微调。STAR-VAE在无条件MOSES采样下实现了100%的有效性和近乎完美的新颖性，在十个GuacaMol描述符中的五个上取得了最低的KL散度，在合成可及性条件控制下以98%的有效性达到Spearman ρ = 0.62的相关性，并对三个Tartarus蛋白质靶点实现了方向性的对接分数控制。在四个ChEMBL靶点上，基于种子的后验采样能够恢复与靶点相关的保留支架，而标签条件采样则生成结构……（摘要在此处被截断）
tldr: STAR-VAE提出了一种将双向编码器与自回归解码器相结合、通过属性信号联合条件化先验/后验/解码器并支持LoRA高效微调的可扩展潜变量Transformer变分自编码器，实现了100%有效性的高质量可控分子生成以及定向的分子性质与对接分数控制。
en_tdlr: STAR-VAE introduces a scalable Transformer-based variational autoencoder that combines a bidirectional encoder with an autoregressive decoder, jointly conditions the prior, posterior, and decoder on property signals, and leverages LoRA adapters for efficient fine-tuning, achieving 100% validity and directional control over molecular properties and docking scores.
